name: Autopilot AI
summary: A local-first workspace for turning raw footage into reviewed video drafts.
intro: A local-first workspace for turning raw footage into reviewed video drafts.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: Bring drafting, media review and video assembly into a deliberate workflow, while keeping costs and publishing decisions under the creator’s control.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: Channel-scoped media previews, scene candidates, explainable clip ranking, creator-written caption cards and approved local MP4 draft assembly. A Next.js interface connects to FastAPI, SQLite and FFmpeg.

sections.heading: Where it stands
sections.body: V0.5 is a local development project. Automatic speech transcription, YouTube uploading and production-ready authentication are not implemented. Its source repository is currently private.

name: Project JARVIS
summary: Exploring what a personal AI assistant can do on a laptop, close to its owner.
intro: Exploring what a personal AI assistant can do on a laptop, close to its owner.

sections.heading: The question
sections.body: What would an assistant look like if local ownership, practical hardware limits and extensible skills shaped the design from the start?

sections.heading: The exploration
sections.body: An early personal project on a Windows laptop, focused on learning how models, memory and modular capabilities fit together.

sections.heading: Where it stands
sections.body: This is an exploration, not a finished autonomous assistant. Local models still have context, capability and hardware limits; running locally does not make intelligence unlimited.

name: Omnitrix Simulator
summary: A playful interface experiment inspired by a familiar childhood gadget.
intro: A playful interface experiment inspired by a familiar childhood gadget.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: Translate the feeling of a physical transformation device into a browser interface and a set of watch-face visual experiments.

sections.heading: The focus
sections.body: Explore a compact circular interface, distinctive visual states and playful interaction. A small project where the interface itself is the experiment.

sections.heading: Where it stands
sections.body: A personal, unofficial fan-made simulator and visual study. It is not affiliated with the original franchise and does not claim a working smartwatch hardware integration.
